added: UUID format toggles (case, braces, hyphens) and bulk generation saved to a file.
Hash lets you choose which algorithms run and adds a Verify panel that checks a pasted digest against every selected algorithm.
JWT shows relative and absolute time for claims with a live-updating clock, and flags unsigned tokens.
Cron's guided builder replaces the old free-text description box, with a field-by-field breakdown.
changed: Image to Text overlays selectable text directly on the image instead of a separate box, and marks uncertain regions on the image itself.
Image to Text, PDF, and Images split out of the old "Bucket" grouping into their own sidebar tools.
Base64 converts live as you type, and builds and decodes data URIs in place.
fixed: Image to Text no longer misreads sideways or rotated photos as "no text found."
